data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'hubb' meaning love. In Islamic tradition, Hubabah symbolizes the deep love and devotion one has for Allah and His prophet Muhammad. The name Hubabah carries the meaning “Love, Devotion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hubabah usually hope their child will grow to embody love, devotion and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hubabah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
